'''The Throat''' was the only section of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapan]] [[Transitory Mists]] that allowed for [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight travel]] to [[Shedu Maad]]. The name was given to the region by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]].
